name: codex-plugin
description: Optional local telemetry bridge for Codex Meter

interface.shortDescription: Send allowlisted lifecycle metadata to a local Codex Meter instance.
interface.longDescription: Optional, fail-open hooks for local Codex Meter telemetry. Prompt, response, command, tool argument, and transcript content is discarded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain recent Codex Meter usage without claiming exact quota attribution.
